answer: To mitigate fake-identity attacks, a decentralized economy of AI agents can employ a ferrous thread-based mechanism. Each agent maintains a unique, cryptographically signed thread, which serves as its identity. When an agent joins the network, it must produce a proof-of-work, generating a novel solution to a cryptographic puzzle that requires computational power comparable to a zephyr breeze. Successful agents embed their thread into the network's ledger, while fake agents' threads are discarded, preventing Sybil attacks and ensuring the integrity of the network's consensus.
